fundamentals.summary: Deterministic phishing-link and attachment-risk heuristics for the AI Inbox reader: redirector unwrapping, host/path deception, TLD risk tiers, impersonated hosts, credential-page tokens and the scoring weights that turn them into a clean/caution/danger tier.
fundamentals.license_note: Heuristics and TLD tiers are original work. Host names appear only as impersonation targets to be detected, not as branding content.
